name: National government offices serving BARMM
note: National agencies’ offices that serve the region, with what each is for. Read on 23 October 2026 from the agencies’ own pages and documents, their official Facebook pages, and news of an office opening; each line’s source is given. Many of these offices publish little: an empty field is one no official source showed. Pag-IBIG Fund’s Cotabato branch is not here because no source gave its address.
